tests.title: User Registration (Valid Data)
tests.description: Register a new user account with unique username, email and password
tests.expected: HTTP 200, user created with role='user'

tests.title: Duplicate Username Registration
tests.description: Attempt to register with an existing username to verify collision handling
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with 'Username already taken' error

tests.title: User Login (Valid Credentials)
tests.description: Authenticate registered user with correct username and password
tests.expected: HTTP 200 OK with authenticated user session & profile

tests.title: User Login (Invalid Password)
tests.description: Attempt authentication with incorrect password
tests.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized with 'Invalid username or password'

tests.title: RBAC Role State Switching
tests.description: Switch system context dynamically between Admin, Guest, and User
tests.expected: Role permissions correctly set to admin, guest, and user respectively
tests.actual: Admin: admin, Guest: guest, User: user

tests.title: Event Catalog Retrieval
tests.description: Fetch all active events with nested ticket tiers
tests.expected: HTTP 200 with all seeded events including Neon Nights & Anime Expo

tests.title: Category-Based Filtering
tests.description: Filter event catalog for category='concerts'
tests.expected: Only concert category events returned in dataset

tests.title: Full-Text Event Search
tests.description: Search events with keyword 'Neon'
tests.expected: Matched events containing 'Neon' in title/venue

tests.title: Price Sorting (Ascending)
tests.description: Sort catalog by price_low parameter
tests.expected: Events ordered in ascending starting_price order

tests.title: Event Details & Tier Breakdown
tests.description: Retrieve single event by ID with all ticket categories and quotas
tests.expected: HTTP 200 with ticket tiers, venue, starting price, and description

tests.title: 10-Minute Hold Reservation
tests.description: Create temporary hold reservation for 2 tickets with 10-minute expiry
tests.expected: HTTP 200, hold created with 600 seconds remaining countdown

tests.title: Excessive Hold Quantity Rejection
tests.description: Attempt to hold quantity exceeding category total quota (99,999 tickets)
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with availability boundary error
tests.actual: HTTP 400, Error: 'Only 248 tickets available for Standard Admission'

tests.title: Database Hold State Persistence
tests.description: Verify hold record persisted in TicketHold table with expiry timestamp
tests.expected: Hold record exists in database and is_expired() is False

tests.title: Booking Confirmation & QR Ticket
tests.description: Execute checkout with UPI payment simulation and generate confirmed e-ticket
tests.expected: HTTP 201 Created, status='CONFIRMED', reference starts with 'EVX-2026-', QR generated

tests.title: Missing Attendee Email Rejection
tests.description: Attempt to book without providing mandatory attendee email
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with validation error
tests.actual: HTTP 400, Error: 'Event, items, and valid email are required'

tests.title: Atomic Inventory Quota Decrement
tests.description: Verify available_quota reduced by exactly booked ticket quantity
tests.expected: Quota decremented by 2

tests.title: Booking Cancellation & 100% Refund
tests.description: Cancel confirmed booking and process 100% refund
tests.expected: HTTP 200, status='CANCELLED', refund_amount equals total_amount

tests.title: Inventory Quota Restoration
tests.description: Verify ticket quota restored back to pre-booking quantity upon cancellation
tests.expected: Available quota restored to 250

tests.title: Admin Dashboard Analytics
tests.description: Fetch administrative KPIs including revenue, total bookings, active events
tests.expected: HTTP 200 with total_revenue, total_bookings, active_events

tests.title: AI Assistant Enquiry & Action Binding
tests.description: Inquire ticket price for Neon Nights Concert via assistant
tests.expected: HTTP 200, response mentions 'starts from ₹999' with action_type='book_event'
tests.actual: Reply: 'The ticket price for Neon Nights Concert starts from ₹999. Would you like to book now?', Action: 'book_event'
